reason: OpenCode 2.x runs shell commands under Accept-edits without asking: the bridge passes bb's policy in OPENCODE_PERMISSION, which opencode 2.0.22 no longer reads (the binary contains no such variable), so no permission request ever reaches the user. Seen live: an Accept-edits OpenCode thread ran `touch` with no approval.
